note: Every token the faucet can drip. amount is a wei string. faucet = which contract redeems the voucher: cyborg-faucet (CyborgFaucet.drip, EIP-712 Drip) or shambaluv-airdrop (ShambaLuvAirdrop.claim, EIP-712 Claim). contract = the verifying contract for the EIP-712 domain. minRung gates the ladder. capPerDay counts drips per address AND per claim sub. Addresses: CyborgFaucet 0x447aE1ACafec942210b8545218a3a5c5C24b3952 is the PREDICTED create3d address (DeltaVerse/deploy/cyborg-faucet-salt.json, salt deltaverse.cyborg.faucet.v1, same on every EVM chain, not yet deployed); SCIEN·TIFIC 0x99999923fAb5D50Df0F3b2F89a49d18EC82Bea79 is the live CREATE2 address on every chain (DeltaVerse/docs/LIVE-CONTRACTS.md) — the 0x4282… address in anvil-deployments.json is a local rehearsal only. RPCs per chain live in chains.json.
